claim: S1 format major 6 minor 3
conditions_and_limits: Original wiki metadata remains separate.

claim: Compressed clusters, approximately 1 MB, LZMA/XZ or Zstandard
conditions_and_limits: Codec dispatch verified; approximate cluster size on original wiki unverified.

claim: Whole archive MD5 at final 16 bytes; integrity only
conditions_and_limits: No authenticity inferred from MD5.

claim: Split archives into .zimaa parts between clusters
conditions_and_limits: Official tool uses cluster offsets; original specification requirement not independently recovered.

claim: Hidden namespaces since 2021; HTTP URL-decode before libzim
conditions_and_limits: Current API namespace behavior verified; historical date and exact wiki decoding instruction inaccessible.

claim: Older readers stay compatible with newer files
conditions_and_limits: Pinned current reader supports selected versions/codecs; does not prove all older-reader/newer-file compatibility.

claim: ZIM is an alternative; adoption/search/editor costs unexamined
conditions_and_limits: GPL and optional Xapian substantiate costs; reviewer checks do not turn candidate deferral into completed integration research.

claim: FTS5 included from 3.9.0; SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5 needed
conditions_and_limits: Built-in flag true; loadable extension is another supported route.

claim: unicode61 U+1ED9 legacy diacritic bug; remove_diacritics=2 handles class
conditions_and_limits: Actual deployed SQLite pin not selected.

claim: No linguistic segmentation of contiguous CJK by unicode61
conditions_and_limits: Letter runs constitute tokens; no CJK word segmentation is provided by this tokenizer.

claim: Trigram <3 character strings never match
conditions_and_limits: No MATCH token for short strings; LIKE/GLOB fallback possible. Short-query product policy not chosen.

claim: Custom tokenizer/fts5_locale as CJK or Thai optional lead
conditions_and_limits: Locale metadata is only useful to a custom tokenizer that implements segmentation; not standalone segmentation.

claim: Porter stemming for English recall
conditions_and_limits: English-only design acknowledged; not a general multilingual stemmer.

claim: 3.4.7-3.4.16 named release/hardening chain and GitHub verified tags
conditions_and_limits: GitHub signature display inspected; no cryptographic tag verification command run.

claim: Any pin below 3.4.16 lacks rawtext and XML fixes
conditions_and_limits: 3.4.15 has XML hardening; rawtext root fix appears in 3.4.16.

claim: Pin sanitizer and recheck upgrades because fixes have refinements
conditions_and_limits: Reviewer code/diff/fixture examination confirms substantive refinement; candidate examined release notes only.

claim: Import/render sanitization mapped to Python service
conditions_and_limits: DOM backend, actual pin/config, attachment order and fail-closed handling not selected. No claim of executed sanitization.

claim: No CVE numbers on fetched release page; lower release range unfetched
conditions_and_limits: No severity derived; reviewer does not expand this into no advisories existing anywhere.

claim: WCAG 2.2 Recommendation 2024-12-12; 4.1.1 removed; 2.4.13 AAA
conditions_and_limits: This identifies a dated edition, not WCAG 2.2 original first-publication date.

claim: 24 by 24 CSS px touch target, timing adjustability, focus not obscured
conditions_and_limits: Target-size and timing exceptions exist; conservative target is valid. AA includes A criteria.

claim: AA audit of chrome plus sampled pages is useful validation
conditions_and_limits: A sampled audit is not evidence of conformance for every full page/process; candidate claims no executed AA result.

claim: Atomic symlink replacement and nonempty-directory constraint
conditions_and_limits: Correctly corrects predecessor single directory-over-directory rename.

claim: RENAME_EXCHANGE equivalent layout
conditions_and_limits: Linux/filesystem support and actual Python binding not selected; same-filesystem swap required.

claim: fsync before rename establishes crash-atomic activation
conditions_and_limits: Post-rename active-parent flush and recovery/publication ordering missing; no crash experiment.

claim: No NFS atomicity
conditions_and_limits: Actual caveat: failed RPC does not prove rename did not occur.

claim: RENAME_NOREPLACE withdrawn because absent in bounded notes
conditions_and_limits: Flag exists on full public source, but candidate correctly limits absence claim to inherited notes.

claim: Pointer flip guarantees coherent page/image/search edition
conditions_and_limits: No edition snapshot across separate opens, assets or search database is specified.

claim: CPython 3.14.8 extraction sanitizes names; Path does not
conditions_and_limits: Code statically inspected; not executed.

claim: ZIP bombs, interruption and overwrite hazards
conditions_and_limits: Per-member/total caps and fresh private staging are added proposals, not built-in protections inferred from docs.

claim: Signatures, pinned trust root, expiry, monotonicity and size limits address thin trust plan
conditions_and_limits: Custom baseline is not full TUF.

claim: Lighter single signature loses indefinite-freeze and mix-and-match defenses
conditions_and_limits: Loss depends on exact signed bundle/expiry protocol; single-key compromise/rotation and offline clock behavior also remain unresolved. Operational burden is a product judgment, not measured evidence.

claim: Content signature plus size manifest defines trustworthy bundle
conditions_and_limits: Exact signed bytes or authenticated content digest is not specified. No executed bypass asserted.

claim: Highest activated is per S7 highest previously seen rule
conditions_and_limits: Authenticated seen floor and activated floor differ; no durable state/rollback policy is given.

claim: Signature approval structures remote preview-and-approve
conditions_and_limits: Preview fidelity and approval binding to immutable bytes not defined.

claim: Trigram first introduced in SQLite 3.34.0, 2020-12-01
conditions_and_limits: This verifies introducing version, not a chosen deployment pin.

claim: F1-F8/D1-D6/C1-C6/O/U/V preserved in full
conditions_and_limits: Every named list item has a disposition, but claimed carried namespace condition is absent. Incorrect critic NFS/release rules persist.

claim: Fetches/rereads executed; architecture and V1-V5 proposed
conditions_and_limits: Original retrieval execution not authenticated; independent sources checked. No candidate lifecycle inputs or product tests inspected/executed.
